from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace')
programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in zeros); r1=max(r for r,c in zeros)+1
    c0=min(c for r,c in zeros); c1=max(c for r,c in zeros)+1
    sh,sw=r1-r0,c1-c0
    # Find the first same-sized non-background source patch, reading from the top.
    source=None
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            patch=[row[c:c+sw] for row in g[r:r+sh]]
            if all(v not in (bg,0) for row in patch for v in row):
                source=patch
                break
        if source is not None: break
    for i in range(sh):
        for j in range(sw):
            g[r0+i][c0+j]=source[i][sw-1-j]
    return g

# Demo pair
inp1=[[2]*12 for _ in range(12)]
pat=[[1,3,3,1],[1,1,3,1],[1,3,3,3],[1,1,1,1]]
for i,row in enumerate(pat): inp1[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(7,11): inp1[r][4:8]=[0]*4
out1=transform(inp1)
expected1=[row[:] for row in inp1]
for i,row in enumerate([[1,3,3,1],[1,3,1,1],[3,3,3,1],[1,1,1,1]]): expected1[7+i][4:8]=row
print('demo matches',out1==expected1)
# Test
inp=[[8]*12 for _ in range(12)]
for i,row in enumerate([[1,1,1,2],[1,1,2,1],[1,2,2,2]]): inp[1+i][1:5]=row
for r in range(9,12): inp[r][2:6]=[0]*4
out=transform(inp)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    g = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])\n    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]\n    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros) + 1\n    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros) + 1\n    sh, sw = r1 - r0, c1 - c0\n    source = None\n    for r in range(h - sh + 1):\n        for c in range(w - sw + 1):\n            patch = [row[c:c + sw] for row in g[r:r + sh]]\n            if all(v not in (bg, 0) for row in patch for v in row):\n                source = patch\n                break\n        if source is not None:\n            break\n    for i in range(sh):\n        for j in range(sw):\n            g[r0 + i][c0 + j] = source[i][sw - 1 - j]\n    return g\n'''
path=programs/'task-d81cfd6e.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
